shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in a green shirt sits at the pinboard-side window seat and asserts that baseline skills are sufficient to be considered accomplished, while a man in an orange shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat, a man in a white shirt sits at the pinboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a blue shirt sits at the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in an orange shirt asks the woman in a green shirt if true accomplishment requires an exceptionally rigorous standard of competencies.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a white shirt replies to the woman in a green shirt and the man in an orange shirt that such an exhaustive standard is impossible to reach.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
